The types every BSGameLib package and a game's shared code agree on: IIdentifiable, INameable, IDescribable, DoNotRegister and extension methods. Added automatically with any BSGameLib package; no need to reference it.

A dedicated game server host on Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting: finds your game's handlers and services, registers them for dependency injection, listens over QUIC and runs a fixed-step game loop, as a console app or a systemd or Windows service.

.NET bindings for SDL3, SDL3_image and SDL3_mixer, generated from the SDL headers, with the native libraries for Windows, Linux and macOS.
A 2D game engine for .NET on SDL3, with Vulkan and OpenGL renderers, shaders compiled at build, content, input, audio, localization and Dear ImGui.
